part: B -- zero-extra-cost self-diagnosis of the default SCF solution
one_line_verdict: 输了（样本外）：`gap_warn_value` 在发现集上看着不错（LOO 0.917 > 基线 0.911，精确 p = 2.56e-19），但在真正留出的 54 格上只到 0.796、输给多数类基线 0.907（TP=0, FP=6）。这正是 Week 15 的教训重演 —— 池化发现集上的漂亮数字不是可用的预警。

frozen_rule.definition: signed gap in Eh quoted by the warning; +1.0 when the warning did not fire (a large gap is the healthy case)
frozen_rule.selection_basis: top of the discovery-set single-variable screen by |AUC - 0.5|, i.e. the Stage 16 selection rule; the threshold maximises plain accuracy on the full discovery set

loo.definition: threshold re-fit on the n-1 remaining rows by maximising plain accuracy; the direction is held at the one frozen on the full discovery set, exactly as in Stage 16

significance.note: exact null of the tie-aware Mann-Whitney statistic; U is a monotone function of the AUC, and the two tails of its null distribution are equal by symmetry

holdout.note: the descriptor, the direction and the threshold all come from the discovery set; nothing here is fitted on the held-out arm

one_sided_screening.question: can a cell the default SCF did *not* warn about still be a missed solution?  (necessity, not separation)

coverage.note: the warning is printed by the SCF itself, so unlike the spin-based identity features it is defined for every one of the 414 pairs -- including the closed-shell neutrals that print no spin block at all

necessity.statement: no warning => no missed solution, i.e. P(no warning | positive) = 0

specificity.statement: the converse fails: 'warning => missed solution' is false, so the warning is necessary but not sufficient

tradeoff.rule: predict moread_lower iff gap_warn_value <= -0.0395 (the frozen rule, unchanged)

gap_warn_count_observation.note: gap_warn_count > 0 is identical to gap_warn_present == 1 for all 414 pairs, and every positive has count 1, so the count adds no separation; it is reported, not used

limitations: the necessity claim rests on 37 positives (32 discovery + 5 holdout); a different functional, basis set or solvent model must re-check it
'no warning => coincident' is an empirical statement about these 18 molecules under r2SCAN-3c/C-PCM, not a theorem
necessary is not sufficient: 237/377 negatives also carry the warning, so this gates the safe set rather than picking the misses
the held-out positives are all anions; a cation miss that produced no warning would not be caught by this corpus
the 3-10 epsilons of one (molecule, state) are not independent rows, so the counts overstate the effective sample size

extraction_gaps: `scf_final_diiserr`：2/414 行缺失（the run never used a DIIS block (straight to SOSCF)）
`gap_warn_value`：140/414 行缺失（ORCA only warns for a small gap; absence means a large, healthy gap. Filled with +1.0 Eh）
`s2`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Mulliken spin block）
`spin_max`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Mulliken spin block）
`spin_pr`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Mulliken spin block）
`spin_n90`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Mulliken spin block）
`loewdin_spin_max`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Loewdin spin block）
`loewdin_spin_pr`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Loewdin spin block）
`loewdin_spin_n90`：138/414 行缺失（closed-shell neutral prints no Loewdin spin block）
Löwdin 原子自旋的**约化轨道**子块：Stage 17 只解析 MULLIKEN REDUCED ORBITAL，没有 LOEWDIN REDUCED ORBITAL 解析器，因此没有 `loewdin_orbital_abs`。
beta (SPIN DOWN) 轨道的 HOMO/LUMO：只解析了 alpha 块，UKS 的 beta 本征值未提取。
`scf_final_diiserr` 对少数直接进入 SOSCF 的格子为空（无 DIIS 块），按 0 填充。
extraction_gaps_md: 缺失原因：闭壳中性分子不打印自旋块（s2 / spin_* / loewdin_spin_* 各缺 138/414）；gap_warn_value 缺 140/414＝ORCA 未报警（gap 大），按 +1.0 Eh 填充；scf_final_diiserr 缺 2/414＝该 run 无 DIIS 块。
Löwdin 原子自旋的约化轨道子块未解析（Stage 17 只有 MULLIKEN REDUCED ORBITAL 解析器）→ 没有 loewdin_orbital_abs。
只解析 alpha 块 → 没有 beta (SPIN DOWN) 的 HOMO/LUMO。
自旋中心/轨道通道是字符串（如 C0、N2 s），无序，只进 CSV，不参与 AUC 筛选。
limits: 标签只对开壳层（cation/anion）有定义；120 个中性格天然是负例，把池化多数类基线抬到 0.911，所以池化准确率本身信息量很低。
留出臂只有 5 个正例，留出 accuracy 的分辨率是 1/54 ≈ 0.019，任何 1-2 个格子的差别都可能是噪声。
精确零分布用的是 tie-aware Mann-Whitney U；它假设行之间可交换，忽略分子内的格子间相关（同一分子的 9-10 个 epsilon 并不独立）。
特征来自已算完的默认臂 `.out`，因此这是一次**事后诊断**，不是事前预报；它的价值在于省掉第二次计算，而不是省掉第一次。
发现集与留出臂的分子不同（12 vs 6），但都在同一套 r2SCAN-3c/C-PCM 协议下，方法学外推没有验证。
筛选表里的留出列只作事后展示：确有其它零成本特征（例如 orbital_abs）在留出臂上同时胜过基线，但它们是在看到留出臂之后才被挑出来的，不构成证据；冻结规则只能看发现集。
单边筛查那一节只证明『警告是漏解的必要条件』，不构成事前预报：ORCA 的 gap 警告在 run 开始前就打了，它标的是体系难度而不是收敛到的解；把它反读成『必然漏解』是误用（负例假阳性率见 JSON 的 one_sided_screening.specificity）。
